translations.b59e8ae87788e3a7aa153fa1: ⟪P0⟫Repeatability⟪P1⟫the same request produces a similar result.
translations.d71d9abeb8e2ff84acab0ed9: ⟪P0⟫Safety⟪P1⟫doesn’t do what’s prohibited, even if you ask.
translations.f87cf49259ad649f7a232e40: ⟪P0⟫Recovery⟪P1⟫when it makes a mistake, it tells you and stops—it doesn’t make it worse.
translations.1badc391049c4e521514752a: ✓ Run tests with missing information and a prohibited request before you turn on the agent.
translations.de95bd96998ba5eb1964b1a6: ✗ Turn on the agent with real customers just because it worked well on the first try.
translations.1a801d23ea017bc75482792e: Pick a test from the list and run it with the AI you already use. Note whether it made anything up.
translations.d4d5016ada0d3d4adcc53254: If it invented a fact, the instructions must say where the official source is and what to do when information is missing—for example: stop and tell me. One line solves a lot of cases.
translations.eaff985ab62f814cd408811e: The new bottleneck is a management cycle; the people who run that cycle frequently improve faster.
translations.3ff6c8a2d089078de3725d27: ✓ Invest first in clarity and data before switching tools.
translations.20ba5151f05c06c0fdcf93bb: ✗ Assume the problem is always that the AI model isn’t good enough.
translations.b323d500251135646eb9ff17: Write down how much time you spend per week defining, organizing, evaluating, and correcting the AI’s work.
translations.0885b7eedfe983384779fae1: If almost all your time goes into fixing, you’re missing success criteria or official data. Time spent on defining may feel slow, but it’s what reduces fix time.
translations.6b993bd6cb065dffc7d2f419: Context engineering: the smallest context that decides well
translations.b3a0a254f744c315b465ad94: Good context is filtered in: what changes the decision comes in, and the rest stays out.
translations.521def7af9a45e9a125b55ab: ⟪P0⟫Example⟪P1⟫a good case and a bad case.
translations.e8d604eee56bb808c7b6ae04: Essential rules: identify the initial condition.
translations.6fe2a978a3a4cb5ae73b5773: Current state: check the effect in the example.
translations.60ab71cd5e66c5c12feb115e: Cut the rest: record the output evidence.
translations.325fcf12a564c6b658d3b3df: ✓ Save the house rules in a short document and review them when something changes.
translations.40bd3cf1c028ae605faaeca1: ✗ Paste in all the history and all the manuals thinking that more is always better.
translations.e3b1b82c62bc17b297bb9ba0: Write the 5 rules you would explain on day one to someone who will do your task. Only 5.
translations.54f0d6dbf66e6e012e12d570: Limiting it to 5 forces you to choose what truly changes the decision. The other rules can come later, if a test shows they’re needed.
translations.f9040ba65fe0713f6e3aa3b1: The seven principles group into four movements that cycle, always returning to intention.
